scientific.integrity: The motivating full PDF was inspected at the model equation, smooth-vector-field statement, disease-free equilibrium, reproduction number, Theorem 3.4 and its b=0 comparison-system proof, and the concluding interpretation. The b=0 page and original model page were also visually inspected. Open saturated-treatment literature was inspected for the regular rI/(1+sigma I) formulation, while the 2008 primary paper was used only for bibliographic provenance because its full text was not available in the inspected open sources. The bundled symbolic checker replays the singular-limit identities. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns the singular endpoint b=0 at fixed positive treatment capacity a. It does not rule out a separately defined nonsmooth capacity-limited model or a regular linear-treatment limit, and it does not reassess the source's results for fixed b>0.

title: The zero-saturation limit destroys the disease-free equilibrium in the printed COVID-19 model
